title: On rates of convergence for sample average approximations without smoothness
summary: Sample average approximation (SAA) replaces an intractable expected objective by an empirical average and is a basic device of modern stochastic optimization. We develop a rate theory for optimal values and empirical $\varepsilon$-minimizers that does not assume continuity, lower semicontinuity, or smooth perturbation structure of the sample objectives.
